decision: Selected the area centroid of the Project Area of the Stillwater Data Center Economic Development Project Plan (published legal description, Section 36, T20N, R2E of the Indian Meridian, 386.698 acres stated), reconstructed by traversing the published metes and bounds from the Bureau of Land Management PLSS corner of Section 36, as the campus locator; the City places Google's land acquisition at the intersection of Perkins and Richmond Roads, which the City street centrelines put at that section corner.

selected_properties.legal_description: Project Area: NE/4, NW/4, SW/4 and SE/4 of Section 36, T20N, R2E, I.B.&M., Payne County, north of the Eastern Oklahoma Railway right of way, less a 30-acre exception on the north line; surveyed March and August 2024; containing 16,844,572 sq ft or 386.698 acres
selected_properties.basis_of_bearing: N 00 41 24 W along the west line of the SW/4

facts.anchor: BLM PLSS CadNSDI Section 36 (FRSTDIVID OK170200N0020E0SN360) north-west corner vertex [-97.0517866, 36.1737672], queried with outSR=4326
facts.computation: Traverse computed in NAD83 / Oklahoma North (EPSG:2267, US survey feet) with pyproj 3.7.1, treating the published bearings as grid bearings; curves drawn from the published chord bearing, chord and radius (24 segments each); POB is the W1/4 corner reached from the anchor by the reverse of the first published leg; the Less-and-Except tract is traversed from the NE corner of the NW/4 and subtracted.
facts.interpretation: The third railroad leg is published as N 54 28 57 E 20.00 ft; it is read as N 54 28 57 W, the radial 20 ft step between the published radii 2793.96 ft and 2773.96 ft (the matching outward step S 44 24 34 E restores the radius to 2793.69 ft). This changes the centroid by under 1 m.
facts.closure_sensitivity: Closing the misclosure on the final leg moves the centroid 2.7 m (net 380.146 acres).
facts.street_note: In the City of Stillwater street centreline layer, N Perkins Rd segments and E/W Richmond Rd segments meet at this node; N Perkins Rd runs along the west line and E Richmond Rd along the north line of Section 36.
facts.polygon_vertices_note: Every fourth vertex of the reconstructed net polygon (WGS84), for review only; not published as a boundary.
facts.replaced_point_note: Imported locality point (Stillwater, Wikipedia coordinates), geometry evidence acd64cf6-e494-594b-ab09-08d50e7f3392 (the City news-flash URL with the imported coordinates).
